title: Define wire protocol encoding/decoding
description: Create python/src/lichen/sim/protocol.py. Binary protocol, little-endian. Message types: REGISTER(0x01), OK(0x00), ERR(0xFF), TX(0x10), TX_DONE(0x11), TX_FAIL(0x12), RX(0x20), RX_OK(0x21), RX_TIMEOUT(0x22), TIME(0x30), TIME_OK(0x31). Functions: encode_register(sim_id, node_id, x, y, z) -> bytes, decode_register(data) -> tuple, encode_tx(payload) -> bytes, etc. Use struct module. Comprehensive round-trip unit tests for each message type.
notes: 2026-08-27 implementation completed in python/src/lichen/sim/protocol.py and python/tests/sim/test_protocol.py. Added documented legacy RX 0x20, RX_OK 0x21, and RX_TIMEOUT 0x22 codecs matching rust/lichen-sim SimClient, while preserving current RX_ENTER/RX_PACKET push protocol. Hardened exact-length/trailing-byte checks for REGISTER, TX, TX_DONE, RX variants, TIME_OK, CAD, CAD_RESULT, and ERR; canonicalized CAD result booleans; added uint64 TIME_OK validation and finite coordinate checks; preserved legacy no-channel TX/RX_ENTER/CAD decoding. Validation: Python protocol + NodeServer + RenodeServer suites 159 passed; Ruff format/check passed; mypy passed for implementation and focused tests; cargo test -p lichen-sim passed 2 unit tests plus doc tests; git diff --check passed.
close_reason: Implemented complete little-endian simulator codecs for documented legacy and current message sets, strict malformed/length/range handling, and cross-caller compatibility; 159 Python tests plus Ruff/mypy and Rust lichen-sim tests pass.
